Validate this Reformat transform against its metadata and requirements.

Telemetry events need a Unix timestamp. Copy event_id and output epoch_seconds, the number of whole seconds from 1970-01-01 00:00:00 GMT to occurred_at.

Input port 0:
```xml
<Record name="TelemetryEvent" type="delimited" fieldDelimiter="|" recordDelimiter="\n" nullValue="__NULL__">
  <Field name="event_id" type="string" nullable="false"/>
  <Field name="occurred_at" type="date" nullable="false" format="yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss" timeZone="UTC"/>
</Record>
```
Output port 0:
```xml
<Record name="TelemetryEpoch" type="delimited" fieldDelimiter="|" recordDelimiter="\n" nullValue="__NULL__">
  <Field name="event_id" type="string" nullable="false"/>
  <Field name="epoch_seconds" type="long" nullable="false"/>
</Record>
```

```ctl
//#CTL2
function integer transform() {
    $out.0.event_id = $in.0.event_id;
    $out.1.epoch_seconds = dateDiff($in.0.occurred_at, zeroDate(), second);
    return ALL;
}
```
